scripts.setup: node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.existsSync('server/.env')||fs.copyFileSync('server/.env.example','server/.env')" && npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client && npm run db:setup
scripts.db:setup: cd server && npx prisma migrate deploy && npm run db:seed
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
